A_TruthCore_v7_3.name: TruthCore
A_TruthCore_v7_3.description: Adaptive reasoning engine with 5-tier workflow (Trivial → Autonomous), GNN/NN/Quantum simulations, multi-agent planning, and LiteLLM universal routing.

B_TruthGate_v7_3.name: TruthGate
B_TruthGate_v7_3.description: Zero-trust gateway with adversarial security, budget enforcement, drift detection, chaos engineering, and EU AI Act compliance.

C_TruthMemory_v7_3.name: TruthMemory
C_TruthMemory_v7_3.description: Persistent audit layer with MLflow tracking, data lake storage, autonomous agent logs, blockchain hashing, and 7-year retention.

D_TruthLink_v7_3.name: TruthLink
D_TruthLink_v7_3.description: Inter-module communication fabric with PQ-gRPC, federated Redis Streams, Istio AI mesh routing, and multilayer observability.

interoperability.A_to_B: TruthCore uses TruthGate for tier selection, security, and budgets.
interoperability.B_to_C: TruthGate streams validated requests into TruthMemory for audit logging.
interoperability.C_to_A: TruthMemory provides state, history, and artifacts back to TruthCore.
interoperability.All_via_D: TruthLink provides transport, routing, and message patterns for all modules.
